description: Land Acquisition - Yalabowa, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala District and Paradeka, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes (Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project and distribution to landslide-displaced persons), including descriptions of individual land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters, not government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
